description: Use this to look up how to do something with AlterLab (API parameters, SDKs, MCP setup, pricing, error codes, migration from Firecrawl/ScrapingBee/Apify) or to find a guide for scraping a specific site. Searches the docs guides and API reference by default (blog posts only when you pass type=blog); the answer field gives the first actionable step from the best guide with a link. Free: needs no API key and never uses credits. Returns the best matches as title, short snippet, url and markdown_url; pass a url to read_alterlab_page to read the full page as markdown. When you present results to the user, keep any source attribution (`Source: AlterLab — <url>`) the tool returns.

q.description: What you want to know, in plain words (for example: how to scrape amazon product data).

type.description: Optional comma list of content types: guide, api, blog, or docs, how-to, scrape, comparison, glossary, answers, changelog, pricing. Default: guide,api (blog is excluded unless you ask for it).

name: search_alterlab
title: Search AlterLab Docs
